name: Mysterious Boy
source:
An emotionless child whom Sayone occasionally meets. They seem to have some kind of strange connection between them.
He wears scarlet stone earrings, the stones ring often and make a sound similar to that of a bell.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
